name: Kamisama,
source:
This is the story of a traitor who extended his hand from the depths of despair to salvation.

It is a story written on the motif of the the twelve apostles of the New Testament. With Judas as the lead. It is an ensemble drama written from the angles of various apostles with Judas on top.

(Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5570]Freem[/url])
translation:
这是一个背叛者从绝望深处伸出手，寻求救赎的故事。

本作以《新约》中的十二使徒为题材，以犹大为主角，从包括犹大在内的多位使徒的视角，展开一出群像剧。

（译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5570]Freem[/url]）
